visualCharacteristics: A two-column feature layout on a solid dark background. Each column holds a heading, supporting text, and a stack of feature/benefit items (app features on the left, partner-benefit badges on the right).
contentPattern: Columns (two columns): one row with two columns — [heading + text + feature items | heading + badge items].
usage: A dark feature/benefits section presenting two related content regions side by side, distinct from a CTA button row.
